title: Hearty Moroccan Narutomaki Tagine
description: A funkily chunky tagine that blends Moroccan spices with delicate narutomaki fish cakes, sweet potatoes, and chickpeas, delivering a monsoon-seasoned, diabetic-friendly punch of flavor.

ingredients.name: Spice blend
ingredients.notes: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 0.5 tsp cinnamon

instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and red bell pepper, sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Stir in sweet potato cubes and cook for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle the spice blend over the vegetables, stir to coat evenly.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a gentle simmer, then add drained chickpeas and sliced narutomaki sticks.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender and flavors meld.
Stir in lemon zest, season with salt and pepper, and remove from heat.
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
